result.what_this_is: Index-calculus configurations -- each a choice of factor base, target source, decomposition oracle, polynomial solver and relation matrix -- run end to end against a planted logarithm, with counted phase costs in group-addition equivalents divided by sqrt(r); consult cost_qualification for unpriced work.
what_this_is_not: not a speed claim: a configuration on a known-answer instance is a measurement, and a comparison needs the matched reference rows AGENTS.md section 1 asks for
not a wall-clock benchmark: operation counts are the metric, wall time rides along
not a claim about any deployed curve
